item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.0 adds a four-tab settings window, per-event notification controls, launch at login, signed update checks, and new application branding.
- Project labels now show only the immediate group and project slug. - OAuth opens in the system default browser; connected accounts show Disconnect instead of another sign-in button. - Notifications can be selected for started, passed, warning, failed, canceled, and skipped pipelines. - Preferences include Open at login and Automatically update. The right-click menu includes event choices and Check for Updates. - When no pipelines are running, the indicator shows three empty circles without a number.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening the downloaded build.
The first installation of this updater-enabled version is manual for earlier local builds. Future releases can be discovered from Check for Updates or through the optional automatic update setting.
